parsed.explanation: No trans-specific statute, cross-dressing offence, or documented universal-exposure rule (border document checks, facility bans, custody placement for visitors) appears in the dossier, so the worst tier-1 machinery isn't evidenced. But the surrounding record is severe and largely negative: an unremedied 2018 state-directed 'witch hunt' — committees to identify and punish homosexuals, internet scouring, forced anal examinations and police torture — shows the law used as a lever against visibly gender-nonconforming people, and its recurrence is unrefuted. The June 2024 abduction and mutilation of a trans activist, condemned by the UN, shows societal hostility without demonstrated recourse. Criminalisation (life imprisonment for sex between men; up to five years in the semi-autonomous jurisdiction), online blocking of LGBTIQ sites, and no functioning complaints route compound the exposure. Documented positives are thin paper commitments (healthcare non-discrimination, media codes), not enforced practice. Dated crackdowns are weighted as history, but the current climate justifies High Risk, above thin-data midpoints.
